description: Source code for IRQ handling and NVIC initialization for ARM Cortex-M3 in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including functions for priority setup, interrupt enabling, and soft interrupt generation.

methods.name: NVIC_InitVector
methods.description: Initializes NVIC vector with specified priority and enables it.

methods.name: Irq_Init
methods.description: Initializes NVIC priority grouping and sets lowest priority for system exceptions.

methods.name: Irq_EOI
methods.description: End of interrupt; not applicable on Cortex-M3, placeholder for future implementation.

methods.name: osPrioToCpuPio
methods.description: Converts AUTOSAR priority to NVIC priority scheme.

methods.name: Irq_EnableVector
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ vector with given priority.

methods.name: Irq_GenerateSoftInt
methods.description: Generates a software interrupt by setting pending bit.

methods.name: Irq_GetCurrentPriority
methods.description: Retrieves current interrupt priority from the controller.
